abertura: At a hotel desk, anywhere in the world, they ask you the same three things.
Mark the three sentences that are true. *Marque as tres frases verdadeiras.*

itens.t: The questions are short -- about five words.
You have to understand every word to answer.
You can ask them to say it again.
One sentence is enough for each answer.

sec1.rationale: Three questions, five words each, and the same ones every time. Asking for a repeat is normal -- people do it in their own language, at every desk.

nota.titulo: Esta e a cena que voce ja viveu
nota.texto: Voce ja passou por esse balcao varias vezes, e se virou. Hoje a gente troca o gesto pela frase — e a frase e curta.

abertura: Choose the right meaning. *Escolha o sentido certo.*

nota.texto: Sorry, again please? e More slowly, please. Com essas duas voce nunca fica sem saida — e nenhuma das duas diz que voce nao sabe ingles.

doc.titulo: At the desk -- what they say
doc.texto:
Emma: Good morning. What is your name, please?

Emma: Thank you. And how many nights?

Clara: Would you like breakfast in the morning?

abertura: What is each question asking for?

itens.t: "Would you like breakfast in the morning?"

nota.texto: Nome, noites, cafe da manha. As frases mudam de hotel para hotel; as tres informacoes, nao. E as suas respostas ja estao prontas desde a aula 1.

abertura: Choose the answer that fits the question.

itens.t: You did not understand the question.

nota.texto: Four nights. e uma resposta completa num balcao. Nem tudo precisa de frase longa — precisa de ser dito em voz alta.

abertura: Mark the three sentences that are true about the three questions.

itens.t: The first question asks for a name.
They ask how you are travelling.

sec5.rationale: Two voices, three questions, said slowly. Nothing about a passport and nothing about the trip -- those are other conversations, in other lessons.

nota.texto: Num hotel real, quem pergunta muda no meio — uma pessoa faz o check-in e outra pergunta do cafe. Reconhecer que mudou a voz ja ajuda a acompanhar.

abertura: Complete your answers. *Complete as suas respostas.*
Use the dates of your next trip, if you know them.

nota.titulo: Cinco frases, e o balcao inteiro
nota.texto: Tres respostas e dois pedidos. Com essas cinco voce faz um check-in do comeco ao fim — e e o que voce vai fazer na aula 4.

itens.t: "Would you like breakfast in the morning?"

cl2.prompt: Two of these keep the conversation going. Which two?
cl2.rationale: The two that work ask for something and keep you in the conversation. The two that do not end it -- and then the desk resolves everything by gesture, which is what already happens on your trips.

abertura: Your five sentences at the desk.

callout.titulo: A frase mais util das cinco
callout.texto: More slowly, please. Ela nao diz que voce nao sabe ingles: diz que voce quer ouvir de novo. E qualquer pessoa num balcao atende a esse pedido sem pensar duas vezes.
